Indian Stock Markets See Mixed Performance Amidst Corporate Earnings

Indian stock markets experienced a mixed opening on July 20th, with the BSE Sensex declining 230.95 points to 76,521.02 and the NSE Nifty dipping 57.15 points to 23,937. This decline occurred amidst surging crude oil prices. In contrast, Eternal Limited reported a significant jump in its first-quarter profit, nearly quadrupling to ₹25 crore compared to the previous fiscal year. Market experts and platforms like MarketSmith India and Sumeet Bagadia provided stock recommendations for the day.
